A claim ('the URPS split is definitively not in the archive') asserted faster than it was checked. The defect is verification discipline before speaking, which no assertion in this package can enforce.
Same shape: a count stated before it was computed. The remedy is checking before reporting, not a code path.
Same shape: a row count asserted from memory rather than from a query.
A capability claim about an external download mechanism, stated without attempting it. Nothing in this package can test whether somebody tried before concluding.
Reinventing a GFM table renderer that already existed. A 'do not reimplement' rule has no executable form; the repo-hygiene duplicate-definition gate covers the in-package case.
The same red build fixed twice in opposite directions across two sessions. This is a coordination failure between agents, not a computation.
Documentation regenerated in a tree somebody else was editing. Concurrency between humans; no assertion applies.
A running status reported for a process dead seven minutes. The remedy is checking the process before reporting it.
A branch reverted a fix main already had. Git-level coordination; the merge, not the code, was wrong.
Manuscript tables carrying no run identity. The manuscript artifacts are not in this repository -- see the manuscript-artifact-sync work, which must run where output/ lives.
A capture rate that is true and misleading. The number and its denominator are produced outside this package; asserting it here would test a fixture.
